scope: Shared header only; other page designs retain their existing source.

decisions.theme: Single sun/moon button; initial system preference, then persisted light/dark.
decisions.unavailableNavigation: Static labels with upcoming semantics; no broken links.
decisions.unverifiedData: No fabricated Core version, star count or account control.
decisions.logo: Original alpha mask preserves wordmark shape; colored symbol remains original pixels in both themes.
decisions.fonts: Inter served locally; header scope only.
decisions.responsive: Six links and content badge at >=1280px; compact native details below; extended search at >=1600px.
decisions.notice: No global mock notice strip; requested removal applies in every build mode.
